sections.title: Officiant
sections.budget_scope: $500 total; include required travel, tax and any agreed rehearsal. No vendor selected.

vendors.published_price: $350 + stated 5.3% tax for covered locations outside lower-priced local zones; rehearsal +$150.
vendors.scope: Virginia ceremony; up to 90 minutes onsite; travel/personalization included.
vendors.gaps: Confirm venue, 185-guest scope, assigned officiant authority and 2027 dated total. Small-wedding arbor/speaker are not assumed sufficient.
vendors.budget_status: conditional: current ceremony $368.55; with rehearsal $526.50 exceeds cap. A provisional 4% sensitivity gives $383.29 or $547.56; source effective year remains unknown.

vendors.name: Matt Sims Wedding Officiant
vendors.scope: Custom ceremony; site states MD/VA/DC service.
vendors.gaps: 2027 date, travel/tax, rehearsal need and jurisdiction authorization unknown.
vendors.budget_status: conditional: lower-range complete quote may fit; upper ceremony plus rehearsal does not

vendors.name: Karen Gray
vendors.gaps: 2027 availability, exact inclusions, travel and legal qualification for venue jurisdiction.
vendors.budget_status: conditional: lower-range only, with all extras inside $500

sections.recommendation: Compare Ciao Bella for a Virginia venue and Matt Sims across jurisdictions. Do not spend assumed savings. Confirm the officiant under the ceremony jurisdiction rules; Virginia reference: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/circuit/marriage/celebrant-information. Unknown effective price years must be clarified; apply 4% annually to genuinely older dated pricing, not an invented source year.

sections.title: Liability and cancellation insurance

vendors.name: Markel
vendors.published_price: Advertised minimums: $75 liability / $130 cancellation; actual wedding quote unknown.
vendors.scope: Both policy types; compare required limits and cancellation exposure.
vendors.gaps: Venue wording, state eligibility, host-liquor terms, exclusions, dates, deductibles, actual premiums/fees. Low-price floors do not establish adequate coverage.
vendors.budget_status: unknown: retain $700; no minimum-price saving recorded

vendors.name: WedSafe
vendors.published_price: Premium unknown; liability FAQ lists $1,000 third-party property-damage deductible.
vendors.scope: Both policy types; compare equivalent coverage.
vendors.gaps: Full 2027 premium, limits, exclusions, venue requirements; deductible is additional potential exposure.

sections.recommendation: Compare actual policies before deposits; keep $300/$400 pending quotes. Liability, venue additional insured, host liquor and setup/strike periods must match contract; cancellation limits must match nonrefundable exposure. The $5,000 Markel cancellation rider is not assumed sufficient. No forms or purchases submitted.

Preserve approved cap and protected reserve; close any $5/$20 gap by explicit planning-category reconciliation. Current statutory fees are not represented as inflation-derived 2027 fees.

sections.title: Thank-you cards and postage scope
sections.budget_scope: $150 thank-you cards. Postage is a $0 gift; whether it includes thank-you mailings is unconfirmed.

vendors.published_price: $14.99 for 40 cards and envelopes; 3 packs $44.97 before tax/shipping.
vendors.scope: Economical sage/ivory-style blank notes, 120-card purchase illustration.
vendors.gaps: Actual household/gift recipient count, future stock, tax/shipping and thank-you postage gift scope.
vendors.budget_status: conditional: 100 standard mailings plus 120-card purchase = $126.97 before tax/shipping at current prices; provisional 4% on cards makes $128.77 with current postage assumption

vendors.name: Staples custom thank-you cards
vendors.published_price: Wedding print page advertises from $54.99 for 25.
vendors.gaps: Final quantity/configuration, envelopes, tax, shipping, postage and 2027 price.
vendors.budget_status: not a fit at four starting-price 25-card batches: $219.96 before extras; other bulk configuration unknown

vendors.name: USPS First-Class Mail
vendors.scope: Mailing service; card must meet weight, shape and machinability rules.

At 120 mailings current cards+stamps = $143.37 before tax/shipping; cap is tight. Gifted save-the-dates, invitation design/addressing, invitations/RSVP cards and postage remain zero-cash gifts; confirm scope/timing without claiming new savings.

sections.title: Seating chart, necessary signs and table numbers
sections.budget_scope: $180 seating chart/signage + $35 table numbers. Floral/decor tax allowance is separate within the same category; avoid duplicate tax.

vendors.published_price: $19.99 displayed for default 12×18 foam board; table-number B&W printing from $0.34/page on wedding page.
vendors.scope: Custom seating-chart/sign print and table-number printing.
vendors.gaps: Readable final 185-guest chart size, 19-number stock/cutting/folding, easel/holders, proof, pickup/shipping and tax. Floor prices are not a complete quote.

vendors.name: FedEx Office
vendors.scope: Official wedding seating-chart and table-number products; mounted poster option.
vendors.gaps: Final-size proof, stock, quantity, stands, pickup/shipping and tax. Multi-product bundle price is not one poster price.

sections.recommendation: Use matching ivory/sage designs and readable print. Couple owns guest/table data and final proof; coordinator scope must assign pickup, placement and removal. Check included venue easel/holders before purchasing. Plan 19 numbers then reconcile actual layout. Complete pricing remains open; no savings or 2027 availability assumed.

sections.title: Emergency kit and miscellaneous
sections.budget_scope: $200 total allowance; purchase only missing supplies after coordinator inventory.

vendors.name: Pinch Provisions Minimergency Kit for Brides
vendors.gaps: Review contents and coordinator supplies; not a complete wedding-day supply plan. Tax/shipping and future stock unknown.
vendors.budget_status: conditional: optional item under cap; retain remaining misc. allowance

sections.recommendation: Administrative responsibility belongs to couple/coordinator. Inventory existing supplies first; fill gaps such as safety pins, sewing kit, stain wipes, tissues, fashion tape and pens. Assign named custodian and accessible storage. The $200 is a ceiling for kit plus misc., not a shopping target. No purchase or saving recorded.

sections.title: Vendor tip ledger
sections.budget_scope: $2,000; internal allocation and distribution responsibility, not a new vendor.
sections.recommendation: Couple approves recipient/role, contractual charge, discretionary amount, payer, due date and distribution record. Coordinator distributes only if that duty is agreed. Check actual contracts: service charge does not automatically establish a voluntary tip. Do not double-count required gratuity already included in venue/catering costs. Keep total within $2,000 and unused funds unallocated; no universal percentage or savings assumed.
